principles: Only fix the documented correctness gap: root docs need an explicit migration policy before files move.
Preserve host-neutral entrypoints for Codex CLI, Claude Code, and human readers.
Keep claims consistent: a migration guide is not a Production Safety unlock or authority readiness proof.
Prefer reversible, auditable documentation changes over broad file churn.
drivers: Root Markdown files mix host entrypoints, legacy compatibility docs, requirements decisions, baseline plans, and personal notes.
Moving root files without a policy would break references and confuse host-specific discovery.
The user requested a small story and audit check, not a broad root cleanup.

options.name: A: Add a requirements decision migration guide and NAV entry
pros: Puts the policy in the truth-source area.
Gives a concrete file-by-file map without changing behavior.
Keeps the change small enough for audit and review.
cons: Root clutter remains until a later execution story actually moves files.

options.name: B: Move all non-entrypoint root docs now
cons: High reference-churn risk and easy to mix unrelated Layer4/Production Safety claims into a doc placement story.
Would exceed the small-story scope and make review harder.

options.name: C: Put a short note only in docs/guide.md
cons: Too weak as a requirements/source-of-truth decision and easy to miss during future migrations.

chosen: A: Add a requirements decision migration guide and NAV entry
rationale: Option A fixes the real correctness issue: it creates a stable, auditable migration contract before any root-file movement. It preserves host-neutral entrypoints and avoids arbitrary optimization or unrelated Production Safety claims.

preMortem.scenario: The guide is mistaken for proof that Production Safety is unlocked.
preMortem.trigger: It lists Production Safety root documents without a boundary note.
preMortem.mitigation: Include an explicit audit note saying the guide does not unlock Production Safety or global capability claims.

preMortem.scenario: Future agents move AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md out of root.
preMortem.trigger: The guide does not distinguish host-discovered entrypoints from ordinary documents.
preMortem.consequence: Host startup instructions and session behavior degrade.
preMortem.mitigation: Mark root host entrypoints as stay-root and explain why.

preMortem.trigger: A later move updates filenames but not NAV/backlinks/root redirects.
preMortem.consequence: Users cannot find decisions or old links break silently.
preMortem.mitigation: Document a migration order requiring NAV/backlink checks and optional root redirects before deletion.
